description: List document page IDs, names, nesting, and content lengths without page bodies. Returns the current revision, rootContentLength, totalCount, and hasMore. Use read_page for root or child content; pass this revision as expectedRevision across subsequent reads to detect concurrent edits.

expectedRevision.description: Current document revision from get_document, open_document, list_pages, read_page, or a previous save. A stale revision fails with revision_conflict; retrieve the current snapshot before retrying.

id.description: Document ID returned by search, list_documents, list_project_documents, or create_document; not its URL or slug.

limit.description: Maximum records in this page, from 1 to 50; defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based number of records to skip. Increase by limit while more results are available.

name: list_pages
title: List Pages
